_note: Revision E technical-compatibility evidence (operator order t448u, 2026-10-26). On-chain facts by eth_call and a local anvil fork lock-and-release simulation of the real BaseCommitmentVaultLock bytecode, both at the pinned Base block. Built by scripts/revE/aggregateCompatibility.cjs. A token is never excluded for price, liquidity, volume, market cap or freshness.

method.static: eth_getCode, decimals(), name(), symbol(), totalSupply(), balanceOf(), paused(), owner(), EIP-1967 implementation slot, EIP-1167 pattern
method.simulation: Fork at the pinned block; deploy BaseCommitmentVaultLock (5% fee, Dev Fund), fund a fresh test account (a transfer from a recent holder found in Transfer logs, else a balance storage-slot write confirmed by balanceOf), approve, createErc20Lock for 1 whole token (or the funded amount) with the 1-hour duration, check the Dev Fund received the exact fee and the vault the exact principal, advance to maturity, release, check the recipient received exactly the principal. On a lock failure, a plain transfer to an ordinary address is tried as a diagnostic.

verdicts.compatible: a simulated lock and release passed
verdicts.not_compatible: a funded simulation failed and none passed
verdicts.compatible_static_only: on-chain checks passed; no attempt could fund a test account, so the lock was not simulated (kept, flagged)

reasons.FEE_ON_TRANSFER: fee-on-transfer: the Dev Fund or the vault receives less than the amount sent
reasons.TRANSFERFROM_INTO_VAULT_REVERTS: transferFrom into the vault reverts although a plain transfer works
reasons.TRANSFERS_RESTRICTED: transfers revert for an ordinary funded account at the snapshot block (paused, trading disabled or restricted)
reasons.APPROVE_RESTRICTED: approve reverts for an ordinary account
reasons.RELEASE_SHORT: release delivers less than the principal (share or balance rounding)
reasons.RELEASE_OVERPAID: release moves more than the principal paid out
reasons.FEE_OVERPAID: fee transfer moves more than the fee
